title: union and pipe types not handled the same, unions are deconstructed into the type map

labels.name: orm - annotated declarative
labels.description: issues with the new annotations-based declarative ORM approach

body:
```py
from __future__ import annotations

from decimal import Decimal
import typing

from sqlalchemy import Numeric
from sqlalchemy.orm import DeclarativeBase
from sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped
from sqlalchemy.orm import mapped_column
from sqlalchemy.sql.ddl import CreateTable


class Base(DeclarativeBase):
    type_annotation_map = {
        typing.Union[float, Decimal]: Numeric(11, 3)
    }

class A(Base):
    __tablename__ = "a"

    id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(primary_key=True)
    d1: Mapped[float]  # should be FLOAT
    d2: Mapped[Decimal]  # should be NUMERIC
    d3: Mapped[float | Decimal]   # should be NUMERIC(11, 3)
    d4: Mapped[typing.Union[float, Decimal]]   # should be NUMERIC(11, 3)

print(CreateTable(A.__table__))
```

output:

```
CREATE TABLE a (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	d1 NUMERIC(11, 3) NOT NULL, 
	d2 NUMERIC(11, 3) NOT NULL, 
	d3 NUMERIC(11, 3) NOT NULL, 
	d4 NUMERIC(11, 3) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
```

using pipe, then it works:

```py
from __future__ import annotations

from decimal import Decimal
import typing

from sqlalchemy import Numeric
from sqlalchemy.orm import DeclarativeBase
from sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped
from sqlalchemy.orm import mapped_column
from sqlalchemy.sql.ddl import CreateTable


class Base(DeclarativeBase):
    type_annotation_map = {
        float |  Decimal: Numeric(11, 3)
    }


class A(Base):
    __tablename__ = "a"

    id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(primary_key=True)
    d1: Mapped[float]  # should be FLOAT
    d2: Mapped[Decimal]  # should be NUMERIC
    d3: Mapped[float | Decimal]   # should be NUMERIC(11, 3)
    d4: Mapped[typing.Union[float, Decimal]]   # should be NUMERIC(11, 3)

print(CreateTable(A.__table__))
```

output:

```
CREATE TABLE a (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	d1 FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	d2 NUMERIC NOT NULL, 
	d3 NUMERIC(11, 3) NOT NULL, 
	d4 NUMERIC(11, 3) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)


```


note this change is backwards incompatible as we have some test cases that are assuming the first behavior, erroneously.

this issue is related to #11370 and may end up including #11370
